title: Composition: Rule of Thirds
welcome_lead: Divide your canvas into thirds for stronger compositions.
meta_desc: KS3 composition: rule of thirds, focal point, balance.
final_note: Place key things off-centre to make eyes move.

concepts.def: How elements are arranged in artwork.
Grid that divides image into 9 boxes.

Different on each side but still balanced.

walkthroughs.body_html: Draw two lines vertically and two horizontally, splitting your image into 9 equal boxes. Important things go on the lines or at the four intersection points — not dead centre.
Every good composition has a focal point — the main subject. Use sharp focus, bright colour or converging lines to draw the eye there first.
A symmetrical composition feels formal and still. An asymmetrical layout balances a big shape on one side with several smaller shapes on the other and feels more lively.
